title: armeria maritima subsp. halleri
intro: Armeria maritima subsp. halleri, commonly known as the Haller's Sea Thrift, is a subspecies of the Armeria maritima plant, a low-growing, evergreen perennial native to coastal areas in Europe. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Haller's Sea Thrift include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
